about:
Precision Wood Finish has operated in Bismarck, North Dakota since 1994. The family-owned business was started by Don and Cindy and grew from a 2,700-square-foot shop serving Bismarck-Mandan into a 7,600-square-foot facility.

The company provides interior and exterior wood staining and finishing services for residential and commercial clients. Its shop-based process uses spray-applied stains, chemical coatings, glazes, and gel stains, with capabilities including custom color matching across wood species, horizontal spraying of doors, and a three-coat topcoat system. The controlled environment limits VOC exposure and ensures consistent results on items such as cabinetry, millwork, stair systems, entry doors, windows, barn doors, and cedar siding.

Customers range from homeowners refinishing kitchen cabinets and fireplace mantels to commercial projects like the NDSU wall art installation and trim packages for local builders. The company also finishes fiberglass and metal entry systems, patio doors, and specialty items such as bar tops.

Precision Wood Finish differentiates itself by keeping work in-house to control environmental conditions, using wax paper between doors during shipping, and offering custom stain matching that the owners say sets them apart from competitors who only claim expertise.
